data.body: test1_2 cache diagnosis (findings in task 130, number 129). New build: 108 turns, input 10,089,635, cached 9,927,552, uncached 162,083 (1.61%). tokens>bytes is not escaping overhead but provider-side prompt inflation: probe live deepseek-flash with a stored surface as one user message (max_tokens 1) - 229,174 chars -> 72,328 prompt tokens, yet the run recorded 151,537 for that turn. A thinking-mode tool continuation is billed with a surplus tracking the previous turn's reasoning (~0.7-1.0x). context.checkpoint pressureTokens follows the inflated number; context.usage anchor.estimated follows the honest text. From turn 48 replayed screenshots make the wire body up to 4.66x the stored surface (~1.2 MB/turn, not billed). Largest uncached turns (seq 9433: 25,318; seq 10096: 11,794) are provider-side partial cache evictions with 86-91% byte-identical prefix. Real content runs 3.3-4.7 bytes/token.
